reviews.text: My girlfriend and I took a girls trip here from the other side of the country and I have to say, it was the absolute best time of our lives. The resort was even more beautiful than the photos. The thought and planning that went into every nook of the grounds makes every turn you take surprising and breathtaking. So many dofferent little areas to relax and explore. The entire staff throughout the resort were so kind, knowledgeable, and extremely accommodating!! Our room was clean and cozy. The pools were beautiful and the vibe was incredible. We loved that there were only like 2 kids the entire time we were there and they were very well behaved. Its definitely a place more geared towards couples and adults. We're already planning our trip back. I'll never stay anywhere else when we are out that way. reviews.text:
The Scott is ideally located just minutes walking distance from Old Town Scottsdale and features amenities you’d expect from a Resort.  
The pools are spacious and outlined with gorgeous mature palm trees which provide a nice cover for the endless sunny days.   
There is even a beach area in the pool. 
There are multiple seating areas for dining or just chatting with great seating and fireplaces. 
From the second you step into the resort, you will be greeted by lovely spa scents and the lobby (with its grand feel) will not disappoint! 
In summary, it’s a great location with nice staff and a 56 Chev Belair ready to take you anywhere!

The staff was really helpful.  We stayed 3 nights but in 1 night increments.  I messed up my Expedia reservation and they were incredibly patient and helpful (Expedia customer service as well).  Some of the finishes needed restoration, but they were natural wood and not laminate, so that is understandable.  The design of the room was really charming and such a welcome change from the cookie cutter W-hotel look that is so prevalent.  
The private patio on the first floor was so lovely.  Even when it was 100 degrees, the patio was shaded and cool enough to enjoy.  Housekeeping does a great job keeping everything clean and stocked.
Our breakfasts were abundant and enjoyable.  The dinner at the restaurant was fun and the service was excellent.  The only slightly negative comment was about the spa. reviews.title: I would keep looking…
reviews.text: I was misinformed by the front desk multiple times. I was charged for early check in for a room that had no running water, but they did not tell me there was no running water until they took payment for the room. They refused to return the early check in fee, despite providing a room without running water. During check in, they tried to charge $200 instead of a $100 resort fee, which I had to point out to the staff. The wifi is $15 per day, which is not disclosed until after check-in. The room was mediocre… the towel rack was hanging out of the wall, there was no exhaust fan in the bathroom, and there was green limescale covering the grout in the bathroom. The bed was soft (bad mattress). Most disappointing was the staff, who were rude and unreasonable (mind the request to return the $30 check-in fee after learning the room would have no running water). If you’re going to spend this type of money on a hotel, I would spend some time to find something better. The hot chocolate was good, and so was the ambience in the lobby.

reviews.text:
We had a fabulous vacation with The Scott as our home base. Would highly recommend staying here - it's beautifully designed & decorated. 

Amenities that we enjoyed included the pool area, gym, various chill seating areas to relax, a little faux-grassy area with big-connect-4 & corn hole, ice-water   ice-tea in the lobby 24/7, easy parking, and a convenient shuttle that's first-come-first-serve driven by friendly bell-staff!

Would like for the pool to be a bit more chlorinated given  the activities surrounding - but really enjoyed the facilities nonetheless! 

The staff was very helpful throughout our time there so worth a shout out. The location is amazingly convenient to Old Town Scottsdale! The shuttle service will drop you there if you can catch them - location is a great amenity!

Highly recommend

Don’t be fooled by the social media posts - they’re all interesting angles! The truth is you’ll find an older hotel that has had a good remodel, but not a great one; a pool full of 20-something’s, sand from the small walk-in beach entry, and a ton of trash from the surrounding foliage; way too many people then they have room in the pool for, or reservations at their own restaurant; rooms that are jumbled with mismatched furniture, and a queen mattress on a king frame; screaming couples at 1am in the hallway; and a staff that seems tired of everyone (and I kinda don’t blame them).

It was an interesting stay, but unlikely I’ll be back anytime soon.

reviews.text: I’ve been to this resort, many times for dinner, and hanging out by the pool, but this is the first time I stayed there! It was one thing after another, first, they didn’t have the room available that I booked with the lagoon view, which was way more money, so they put us in a pool view that was very bot private. And then we found out that we were attached to the presidential suite and could hear every single thing that was being said underneath the door. And then at the pool we rented a cabana for $250, there was a wedding, so the pool was filled with kids, and there was only one server, and she forgot multiple things, and our drinks took over an hour! And the cabana didn’t come with side, tables or anything. The food is excellent at the restaurant, and the ambience in the main area is amazing, I will definitely be back for that, but I will not stay here again for the price of the room and what you get it’s not worth it.

reviews.title: Unbelievable service
reviews.text:
This place is as beautiful as the photos and has potential to be a really awesome hotel however, the service is the worst service I‘ve ever experienced at a hotel. The bar flat out ignored my husband while waiting to order drinks, then the gal put the order in for our lunch and left for the day so the order was never filled while we waiting an hour wondering what was going on, then they served us the wrong drinks twice… we didn’t ever end up correcting them the second time they got it wrong because it was so laughable. That was just one dining experience. Other days by the pool numerous times they flat out forgot our drink orders. It’s over priced my husband paid $34 for an old fashion. The rooms are ok, but the beds hurt our backs. While it’s been renovated it’s still very obviously an old hotel with dark musty hallways. 
Overall I would never stay there again. For $500 a night the service is laughable. They did attempt to reconcile their poor service my comping, a round of drinks for us and taking a small amount off of our price per night… so I will give them that

The rooms had terrible air flow, very stuffy every night, we had to sleep with the door open, no fan in bathroom and very dark rooms - could’ve  used more windows/natural light. The lobby and staff were great, the lobby is such a nice vibe that makes you feel like you’re not in AZ but more of tropical resort. Hotel restaurant/bar had wonderful drinks, staff and food. reviews.title: So Beautiful that I stayed a few Extra Days!
reviews.text: Beautiful, cuban-themed resort and spa located within blocks from a premium shopping mall and just a few miles from The Phoenix Zoo. The rooms have dim lighting but are moderate in size with gorgeous bathrobes, a spacious closet,  comfortable beds and a large balcony. I recommend booking a courtyard view room which overlooks a stunning oasis with a pool, lagoon, firepits, hammocks, yoga and game area, etc. There are no elevators at the property but the bell staff can assist you with getting your luggage to your room.  Most guests were dressed daytime chic in linen sets, maxi dresses, rompers, etc. This resort and spa is a great value for a relaxing retreat.

reviews.text:
The pictures sold me on booking this hotel but the hotel was even better than the pictures portrayed. The Scott is an amazing hotel that makes you feel like never leaving the property....and we didn't!!! 
It has everything you need to relax and indulge. The outdoor space is so inviting and there are so many private spaces to tuck in and relax poolside and throughout the gardens.  The staff was so friendly, and they really go out of their way to make you feel special. Can't wait to go back!

reviews.title: Perfect oasis near old town

My wife and and I spent our 10th anniversary for a staycation at this resort. Upon arrival, we were greeted by a lovely hostess who promptly checked us in and offered us an upgrade room. Later the bell person dropped off a handwritten note and a bottle of win and some beautiful Arizona cookies compliments of the front desk. 

The pool service was great and the grounds were clean. We ate at the restaurant and it was good and the ambiance was casual chic. All in all an excellent hotel in a perfect location with great staff.
